answer: Each agent identity must post a refundable bond before it can bid, and payments stay in escrow until delivery is verified; proven fraud burns the bond. This does not prove an identity is unique, but it makes a sybil swarm expensive: every fake agent needs separate locked capital, and one caught identity loses its stake. A ridge of cheap accounts cannot multiply influence for free; the delta is the capital cost, whether the attacker names an agent zephyr or anything else.
